original.target_description: Karraker and DeLamater (2013), older opposite-sex married NSHAP respondents, sexual inactivity. Multiple candidate predictors/models/comparisons at supplied page; target test unresolved.

notes: Primary title verified; PDF pp. 10–13 rendered and inspected. Study/description are absent; locator supplies only a page, with no predictor, model or contrast. Page interpreted as PDF/article-relative p. 10 or 11 (printed pp. 151/152); printed journal pp. 10/11 are absent. No target assigned by audit ID, row order or numeric matching. Candidate sample evidence only: Missing Data (printed p. 148/PDF p. 7) identifies 1,502 married respondents (889 men, 613 women), 637,092 person-months, 53,091 person-years. Analytic Approach (printed p. 149/PDF p. 8) explicitly identifies person-month as unit of analysis; Table 3 repeats these roles. Of 1,801 married respondents, 299 excluded: 217 missing last-sex year, 21 other marriage-history information, 61 covariates. Table 1 has pooled and gender-specific descriptives; Table 2 n = 1,462 with age counts 620, 533, 309 excludes missing sexual frequency for some active respondents. Common model counts are candidates for parent field-scope review, not assigned analytic N. No N sums or metric conversions performed. PDF p. 10 contains Table 1 with multiple gender comparisons and starts pooled duration analyses. Referenced Table 3 duration Model 1 OR 1.00 has single-star coefficient (p < .05); duration Model 2 OR 1.22 has triple-star coefficient (p < .001). Quadratic duration is another candidate. Model 2 age also prints OR 1.22 (p < .001), a distinct test. Table 1 gender-comparison p values do not belong to logistic ORs. The page-only locator cannot distinguish these tests. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
